tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar. Matches the logo tile cream in light.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: inputs, pressed rows, segmented-control track, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo outline (logo brown in light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, axis labels. 4.5:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder only; 3:1, never for information.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hearth orange from the logo. Primary buttons, the current period in charts, focus ring. Fill only: never body text on light. 2.3:1 on cream, so a brand fill always carries on-brand text or sits beside an outline; never a brand-only shape that must be seen.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Orange when it has to be text or an icon: links, active tab label, selected state.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, installment chips, active nav pill.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Ember yellow from the logo. Highlights and the second chart series; never text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Income, savings, money coming in, things that went well.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Problems only: over budget, failed sync, overdrawn. Ordinary spending is ink, not red.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale data, needs attention soon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, pending transactions.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background for positive pills.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error pills and banners.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning pills and banners.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 / current period. A deeper hearth orange in light so bars hold 3:1 on cream; the logo orange in dark.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2. Blue against orange stays distinguishable for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3, ember. Darkened in light so bars hold 3:1 on cream.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: Other / previous period / remainder. Holds 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, 2px offset.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one headline number on a screen (left this month, net worth). Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and tables. Tabular figures, never wraps.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, row titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a row title, chart notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (Latin only; Hebrew labels skip the uppercase and spacing).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row, between stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones, gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title, between major regions on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small badges, institution logos.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the app icon tile (scaled).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, segmented controls, avatars.

shadow.note: Shadows are faint and warm; borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards resting on surface-0.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and menus.
